ai: Moscow is the capital city of Russia.
莫斯科是俄羅斯的首都。
It gets very cold in Moscow during the winter.
莫斯科的冬天非常寒冷。
Ken is bringing sandwiches to the picnic this weekend.
肯這個週末會帶三明治來野餐。
I asked Ken to help me carry the boxes upstairs.
我請肯幫我把箱子搬上樓。
That kind of advanced math is beyond my ken.
那種高深的數學超出我的理解範圍。
Most of the technical details were beyond the ken of ordinary readers.
大部分技術細節超出了一般讀者的理解範圍。
Ruth baked a lemon cake for her neighbor's birthday.
露絲為鄰居的生日烤了一個檸檬蛋糕。
I sat next to Ruth during the whole movie.
整場電影我都坐在露絲旁邊。
Processing your order usually takes two or three business days.
處理你的訂單通常需要兩到三個工作天。
The factory is famous for its fish processing.
這間工廠以魚類加工聞名。

processing.zh: 處理、加工（process 的現在分詞）
ai: The website is processing your payment, so please wait a moment.
網站正在處理你的付款，請稍候。
She is processing the photos she took on her trip.
她正在處理旅行時拍的照片。

ha.zh: 哈、哈哈（表示得意、驚訝或笑聲）
ai: Ha, I knew you would pick that one!
哈，我就知道你會選那個！
Ha ha, that joke was really funny.
哈哈，那個笑話真的很好笑。
She dreams of winning an Olympic gold medal one day.
她夢想有一天能贏得奧運金牌。
Many people stayed up late to watch the Olympic opening ceremony.
很多人熬夜觀看奧運開幕典禮。
My grandmother keeps an old Bible on her bedside table.
我奶奶在床頭櫃上放著一本舊聖經。
The Bible has been translated into hundreds of languages.
聖經已被翻譯成數百種語言。
Canada is the second largest country in the world by area.
以面積來說，加拿大是世界第二大國。
My cousin moved to Canada to study engineering.
我表哥搬到加拿大去念工程。
Arthur walks his dog every morning before work.
亞瑟每天早上上班前都會遛狗。
I borrowed this book from Arthur last week.
這本書是我上週向亞瑟借的。

arthur.zh: 亞瑟王（傳說中的英國國王）
ai: According to legend, King Arthur led the Knights of the Round Table.
根據傳說，亞瑟王是圓桌騎士的領袖。
The children listened to a story about Arthur and his sword.
孩子們聽了一個關於亞瑟王和他的劍的故事。

bristol.zh: 布里斯托（英國西部的港口城市）
ai: Bristol is a port city in the west of England.
布里斯托是英格蘭西部的一座港口城市。
We took a train from London to Bristol.
我們從倫敦搭火車去布里斯托。
Nick offered to drive us home after the party.
尼克提議派對後開車送我們回家。
I will ask Nick whether he wants to join us.
我會問問尼克想不想加入我們。
There is a small nick on the edge of this plate.
這個盤子的邊緣有一道小缺口。
He cut himself shaving and got a nick on his chin.
他刮鬍子時割傷了自己，下巴上多了一道小傷口。
Someone nicked my bike while I was in the shop.
我在店裡的時候，有人把我的腳踏車偷走了。
He got caught trying to nick a few sweets from the store.
他想從店裡偷幾顆糖，結果被抓到了。

nick.zh: 千鈞一髮之際（in the nick of time）
ai: We got to the station in the nick of time and caught the train.
我們在最後一刻趕到車站，搭上了火車。
The rescue team arrived in the nick of time.
救援隊在千鈞一髮之際趕到了。
Keith teaches math at the local high school.
基思在當地的高中教數學。
Keith always arrives early for our meetings.
基思總是提早到我們的會議。
Charlie likes to ride his bike along the river.
查理喜歡沿著河邊騎腳踏車。
We asked Charlie to take a photo of the whole group.
我們請查理幫大家拍一張合照。
Anna plays the violin in the school orchestra.
安娜在學校的管弦樂團拉小提琴。
I left a message for Anna, but she hasn't replied yet.
我留了訊息給安娜，但她還沒回覆。
The nurse put an IV in his arm to give him fluids.
護士在他的手臂上插了點滴，給他補充水分。
She was still on an IV when I visited her in the hospital.
我到醫院探望她時，她還在打點滴。
Andy fixed my laptop in less than an hour.
安迪不到一個小時就修好了我的筆電。
Andy and I have been friends since high school.
安迪和我從高中就是朋友。
My little sister turns fourteen next month.
我妹妹下個月滿十四歲。
There are fourteen students in our English class.
我們的英文班有十四位學生。
You have to be sixteen to apply for this part-time job.
你必須年滿十六歲才能申請這份兼職工作。
The bus ride takes about sixteen minutes.
搭公車大約要十六分鐘。
Helen volunteers at the animal shelter every Sunday.
海倫每週日都到動物收容所當志工。
I'm meeting Helen for coffee after work.
我下班後要和海倫去喝咖啡。

newcastle.zh: 紐卡素（英國的港口城市）
ai: Newcastle is a city in the north of England.
紐卡素是英格蘭北部的一座城市。
They moved to Newcastle because of her new job.
因為她的新工作，他們搬到了紐卡素。
Howard runs a small bookstore near the station.
霍華德在車站附近經營一間小書店。
Howard gave us a ride to the airport this morning.
霍華德今天早上載我們去機場。
Dave grills burgers in the backyard every summer.
戴夫每年夏天都在後院烤漢堡。
Could you ask Dave to bring the extra chairs?
你能請戴夫把多的椅子帶來嗎？
Berlin is the capital of Germany.
柏林是德國的首都。
We spent a long weekend visiting museums in Berlin.
我們花了一個長週末在柏林參觀博物館。
Lucy drew a beautiful picture for her grandmother.
露西畫了一幅漂亮的畫送給她的奶奶。
Lucy forgot her umbrella on the train again.
露西又把雨傘忘在火車上了。
Maggie bakes fresh bread every Saturday morning.
瑪姬每週六早上都會烤新鮮的麵包。
I sat beside Maggie during the long meeting.
開那場冗長的會議時，我坐在瑪姬旁邊。

closer.zh: 更近的、更親近的（close 的比較級）
ai: The closer exit is on the left side of the hall.
比較近的出口在大廳的左側。
They became closer friends after working on the project together.
一起做完這個專案後，他們成了更親近的朋友。
Please come closer so I can hear you better.
請靠近一點，我才聽得比較清楚。
The storm is moving closer to the coast.
暴風雨正逐漸逼近海岸。
Roger coaches the neighborhood soccer team.
羅傑負責指導社區的足球隊。
Roger lent me his camera for the trip.
羅傑把他的相機借給我去旅行。
Roger, we will meet you at the north gate.
收到，我們會在北門和你會合。
Pilot to tower, we are ready for landing. Roger that.
機長呼叫塔台，我們準備降落。收到。
Victoria studies biology at the university.
維多利亞在大學念生物。
I'm sending the invitation to Victoria tonight.
我今晚要把邀請函寄給維多利亞。
Kent is a county in the southeast of England.
肯特郡是英格蘭東南部的一個郡。
We drove through the green countryside of Kent.
我們開車穿過肯特郡綠意盎然的鄉間。
Matthew is the first book of the New Testament.
馬太福音是新約聖經的第一卷書。
The pastor read a short passage from Matthew on Sunday.
牧師週日朗讀了馬太福音中的一小段。
Alexander is learning how to play the piano.
亞歷山大正在學鋼琴。
Everyone in the class likes Alexander because he is so kind.
班上每個人都喜歡亞歷山大，因為他很善良。
The price changes depending on the size of the room.
價格會依房間大小而不同。
Depending on the weather, we might cancel the trip.
視天氣而定，我們可能會取消旅行。

depending.zh: 依賴、取決於（depend 的現在分詞）
ai: Many families are depending on this bridge to get to work.
許多家庭要靠這座橋通勤上班。
The team is depending on you to finish the report.
團隊指望你完成這份報告。
The midland of the country is mostly flat farmland.
這個國家的中部地區大多是平坦的農田。
She grew up in a small town in the English midlands.
她在英格蘭中部的一個小鎮長大。

zealand.zh: 紐西蘭（New Zealand 的後半）
ai: New Zealand is known for its beautiful mountains and lakes.
紐西蘭以美麗的山脈與湖泊聞名。
My uncle has lived in New Zealand for ten years.
我叔叔已經住在紐西蘭十年了。
Copenhagen, the capital of Denmark, is located on the island of Zealand.
丹麥首都哥本哈根位於西蘭島上。
Zealand is the largest island in Denmark.
西蘭島是丹麥最大的島。

aha.zh: 啊哈（突然明白或發現時）
ai: Aha, so that's where I left my keys!
啊哈，原來我的鑰匙放在那裡！
Aha, now I understand how this works.
啊哈，我現在懂這個怎麼運作了。
My office is on the sixth floor.
我的辦公室在六樓。
It was the sixth time she had watched that movie.
那是她第六次看那部電影。
A sixth of the class chose to study French.
班上有六分之一的人選擇學法文。
He ate only a sixth of the pizza.
他只吃了披薩的六分之一。
They live in a beautiful Victorian house near the park.
他們住在公園附近一棟漂亮的維多利亞式房屋裡。
The museum has a large collection of Victorian clothing.
這間博物館收藏了大量維多利亞時代的服飾。
Many Victorians believed that hard work was the key to success.
許多維多利亞時代的人相信努力工作是成功的關鍵。
The book describes how a typical Victorian lived.
這本書描述了典型維多利亞時代的人是怎麼生活的。
The workers poured the grape juice into a huge vat.
工人把葡萄汁倒進一個巨大的桶子裡。
The cloth was dipped in a vat of blue dye.
布料被浸入一大桶藍色染料中。
Francis spends his weekends fishing at the lake.
法蘭西斯週末都在湖邊釣魚。
I borrowed a ladder from Francis next door.
我向隔壁的法蘭西斯借了一把梯子。
Alice reads a book before she goes to sleep every night.
愛麗絲每晚睡前都會看書。
I'll pick up Alice from school at three o'clock.
我三點會去學校接愛麗絲。
Terry is helping us paint the living room.
泰瑞正在幫我們粉刷客廳。
I'll ask Terry whether he can come on Friday.
我會問問泰瑞星期五能不能來。
This bathrobe is made of soft terry cloth.
這件浴袍是柔軟的毛巾布做的。
She wiped her hands on a terry towel.
她用一條毛巾布的毛巾擦手。
The old castle was built in the Norman style.
這座古堡是以諾曼式風格建造的。
Many Norman soldiers crossed the sea to England in 1066.
許多諾曼士兵在一〇六六年渡海前往英格蘭。
Colin cooks dinner for his family every Sunday.
柯林每個星期天都會為家人煮晚餐。
Colin showed us the way to the museum.
柯林帶我們走到博物館。

san.zh: 聖（用於地名、人名，如 San Francisco）
ai: We took a ferry across the bay to San Francisco.
我們搭渡輪越過海灣去舊金山。
The church was named after San Juan, a saint from Spain.
這間教堂是以來自西班牙的聖人聖胡安命名的。

san.zh: 先生、小姐（日語敬稱，接在名字後）
ai: In Japanese, you can call your coworker Tanaka-san.
在日語裡，你可以稱呼同事為田中先生。
She greeted her neighbor politely, saying, "Good morning, Sato-san."
她禮貌地跟鄰居打招呼說：「早安，佐藤先生。」
This umbrella isn't mine; I think it's hers.
這把傘不是我的，我想是她的。
My phone is old, but hers is brand new.
我的手機很舊，但她的是全新的。

durham.zh: 達勒姆（英格蘭的郡與城市）
ai: Durham is a county in the northeast of England.
達勒姆是英格蘭東北部的一個郡。
The city of Durham is famous for its old cathedral.
達勒姆市以古老的大教堂聞名。
Laura sings in a choir on Thursday evenings.
蘿拉每週四晚上都在合唱團唱歌。
Please send the file to Laura before noon.
請在中午前把檔案寄給蘿拉。
Islam is one of the major religions in the world.
伊斯蘭教是世界主要宗教之一。
The class learned about the history of Islam.
這堂課學習了伊斯蘭教的歷史。

changing.zh: 改變、更換（change 的現在分詞）
ai: I'm changing my password because it's too easy to guess.
我要換密碼，因為它太容易被猜到了。
She is changing the bandage on her brother's knee.
她正在幫弟弟換膝蓋上的繃帶。
We live in a rapidly changing world.
我們生活在一個快速變化的世界。
Farmers must adapt to the changing climate.
農民必須適應不斷變化的氣候。
My roommate is an Australian who loves surfing.
我的室友是個熱愛衝浪的澳洲人。
Several Australians joined our hiking group.
有幾位澳洲人加入了我們的健行團。
She has a strong Australian accent.
她有濃厚的澳洲口音。
We tried some Australian wine at the party.
我們在派對上嚐了一些澳洲葡萄酒。
Anthony works as a nurse at the city hospital.
安東尼在市立醫院擔任護理師。
I haven't seen Anthony since last summer.
我從去年夏天起就沒見過安東尼了。
Nicholas is saving money to buy a new bicycle.
尼古拉斯正在存錢買一輛新腳踏車。
Nicholas waved to us from across the street.
尼古拉斯在街的另一頭向我們揮手。
Douglas takes the train to work every day.
道格拉斯每天搭火車上班。
We invited Douglas to join our book club.
我們邀請道格拉斯加入我們的讀書會。
She hummed la la la while she washed the dishes.
她邊洗碗邊哼著啦啦啦。
The kids sang "la, la, la" because they forgot the words.
孩子們因為忘了歌詞，就唱起了「啦、啦、啦」。
Jimmy practices the guitar after school every day.
吉米每天放學後都練吉他。
Jimmy shared his lunch with a new classmate.
吉米把午餐分給一位新同學。
Gary repaired our fence over the weekend.
蓋瑞週末修好了我們的籬笆。
I'm going to the gym with Gary after work.
我下班後要和蓋瑞去健身房。
Kate is learning Spanish before her trip to Mexico.
凱特在去墨西哥旅行前正在學西班牙文。
Kate left her notebook on the desk.
凱特把筆記本留在書桌上了。
She is learning Dutch because she plans to live in Amsterdam.
她打算住在阿姆斯特丹，所以正在學荷蘭語。
The Dutch are known for riding bicycles everywhere.
荷蘭人以到處騎腳踏車聞名。
We bought some Dutch cheese at the market.
我們在市場買了一些荷蘭起司。
The museum has many famous Dutch paintings.
這間博物館有許多著名的荷蘭畫作。
Christopher is studying to become a pilot.
克里斯多夫正在讀書，打算成為飛行員。
Christopher is the tallest boy in our class.
克里斯多夫是我們班最高的男生。

essex.zh: 艾塞克斯郡（英格蘭郡名）
ai: Essex is a county in the east of England.
艾塞克斯是英格蘭東部的一個郡。
They live in a quiet village in Essex.
他們住在艾塞克斯一個安靜的村莊。
Oliver loves playing with his toy trains.
奧利佛愛玩他的玩具火車。
Oliver helped his mother carry the groceries.
奧利佛幫媽媽提雜貨。
Lloyd takes care of the garden behind the school.
勞埃德負責照顧學校後面的花園。
I got a call from Lloyd this morning.
我今天早上接到勞埃德的電話。
Dublin is the capital of Ireland.
都柏林是愛爾蘭的首都。
We walked along the river in Dublin after dinner.
晚餐後我們沿著都柏林的河邊散步。
Kevin picked us up at the airport after the long flight.
長途飛行後，凱文到機場接我們。
I asked Kevin to help me move the sofa.
我請凱文幫我搬沙發。
The teacher stopped the fighting between the two boys.
老師制止了兩個男孩之間的打架。
There was a lot of fighting in the crowd after the match.
比賽結束後，人群中發生了不少打鬥。

fighting.zh: 打架、對抗（fight 的現在分詞）
ai: The two brothers are always fighting over the remote control.
兩兄弟總是為了遙控器吵架。
Doctors are fighting to save the patient's life.
醫生們正在全力搶救病人的生命。
The team showed great fighting spirit in the final game.
這支球隊在決賽中展現出強烈的鬥志。
The two dogs were in a fighting mood.
那兩隻狗處於好鬥的狀態。
Diana is the tallest girl on our volleyball team.
黛安娜是我們排球隊裡最高的女孩。
I'll ask Diana to bring the snacks.
我會請黛安娜帶點心來。

continued.zh: 繼續（continue 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: She continued working even though she was tired.
即使累了，她還是繼續工作。
The rain continued all night long.
雨整晚都沒停。
Thank you for your continued support.
謝謝你持續的支持。
The company has seen continued growth over the past year.
這間公司在過去一年持續成長。
Cooking is my favorite way to relax after work.
下班後，做菜是我最愛的放鬆方式。
My father does all the cooking in our house.
我們家的菜都是爸爸煮的。

killing.zh: 殺、使死亡（kill 的現在分詞）
ai: The cold weather is killing the plants in the garden.
寒冷的天氣正在讓花園裡的植物枯死。
Too much stress is killing his health.
過多的壓力正在摧毀他的健康。
The police are investigating the killing of a shop owner.
警方正在調查一起店老闆遭殺害的案件。
The newspaper reported on the killing for several days.
報紙連續幾天報導了這起殺人案。
My feet are killing me after the long walk.
走了這麼久的路，我的腳痛得要命。
The hike up the mountain was a killing climb.
那趟上山的健行爬得累死人。
Westminster is an area in the center of London.
西敏是倫敦市中心的一個區。
Many tourists visit Westminster to see Big Ben.
許多遊客到西敏去看大笨鐘。
The ship slowly crossed the Atlantic.
那艘船緩緩橫越大西洋。
They flew over the Atlantic on the way to New York.
他們前往紐約的途中飛越了大西洋。
A strong Atlantic storm is moving toward the coast.
一場強烈的大西洋風暴正朝海岸移動。
We took a walk along the Atlantic coast.
我們沿著大西洋海岸散步。

ford.zh: 淺灘（可涉水而過的河段）
ai: The hikers crossed the river at a shallow ford.
登山客在一處淺灘過河。
There used to be a ford here before the bridge was built.
橋建好之前，這裡有一處可涉水而過的淺灘。
We had to ford the stream to reach the other side.
我們得涉水過溪才能到對岸。
The cattle forded the river slowly.
牛群慢慢地涉過了河。
Egypt is famous for its ancient pyramids.
埃及以古老的金字塔聞名。
The Nile River flows through Egypt.
尼羅河流經埃及。
My nephew will be thirteen years old next week.
我姪子下週就滿十三歲了。
There are thirteen people on the guest list.
賓客名單上有十三個人。
California is on the west coast of the United States.
加州位於美國的西岸。
We drove along the coast of California last summer.
去年夏天我們沿著加州海岸開車旅行。
Stuart is training for his first marathon.
史都華正在為他的第一場馬拉松做訓練。
Stuart invited us to his housewarming party.
史都華邀請我們參加他的喬遷派對。
Albert collects old coins as a hobby.
艾伯特的嗜好是收集古錢幣。
I met Albert at a cafe near the library.
我在圖書館附近的咖啡館遇見了艾伯特。
Lawrence rides his bicycle to the office.
勞倫斯騎腳踏車去辦公室。
Please give this letter to Lawrence.
請把這封信交給勞倫斯。

managing.zh: 管理、經營（manage 的現在分詞）
ai: She is managing a team of ten people.
她正在管理一個十人的團隊。
He spends most of his time managing the restaurant.
他大部分時間都在經營那間餐廳。
He was promoted to managing director last year.
他去年被升為總經理。
The managing editor reviews every article before it is published.
主編會在每篇文章刊出前審閱。
Billy loves building things with blocks.
比利喜歡用積木蓋東西。
Billy waited at the bus stop for twenty minutes.
比利在公車站等了二十分鐘。
Owen made a card for his teacher.
歐文為他的老師做了一張卡片。
Owen and I walk to school together.
歐文和我一起走路上學。
Rachel brought homemade cookies to the office.
雷切爾帶了自己做的餅乾到辦公室。
I'm going shopping with Rachel this afternoon.
我今天下午要和雷切爾去逛街。
The expected arrival time is six o'clock.
預計的抵達時間是六點。
The results were better than expected.
結果比預期的還要好。

expected.zh: 預期、預料（expect 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: We expected the meeting to be short, but it lasted two hours.
我們以為會議很短，結果開了兩個小時。
She expected her friends to arrive early.
她預期朋友們會早到。
Fred mows the lawn every Saturday morning.
佛瑞德每週六早上都會割草。

Louis plays chess with his grandfather after dinner.
路易斯晚飯後會和祖父下棋。
I saw Louis waiting outside the cafe.
我看到路易斯在咖啡館外面等著。
Bernard waters the plants on the balcony every evening.
伯納德每天傍晚都會幫陽台上的植物澆水。

Drinking enough water every day is good for your health.
每天喝足夠的水對健康有益。

My sister works in banking and often travels for work.
我姊姊在銀行業工作，經常出差。

網路銀行讓人在家就能輕鬆繳費。

斯圖爾特正在寫一份關於當地鳥類的報告。

Poland is a country in central Europe.
波蘭是中歐的一個國家。

華沙是波蘭的首都。

nottingham.zh: 諾丁漢（英格蘭的郡與城市）
ai: Nottingham is a city in the middle of England.
諾丁漢是英格蘭中部的一座城市。

這座公園週末是健行者的好去處。

她走路很快，我幾乎跟不上。
My grandfather uses a walker to move around the house.
我爺爺在家裡走動時會使用助行器。

寶寶藉著學步車學會了站立。
Sheffield is a city in the north of England.
雪菲爾是英格蘭北部的一座城市。

她在雪菲爾的一所大學念工程。
Kelly runs three miles before work every morning.
凱莉每天早上上班前都會跑三英里。

凱莉從義大利寄了一張明信片給我。

克萊爾空閒時會畫風景畫。
I'm having lunch with Clare tomorrow.
我明天要和克萊爾吃午餐。

improved.zh: 改善、進步（improve 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: Her English improved a lot after she moved abroad.
她搬到國外後，英文進步了很多。
The company improved its service by hiring more staff.
這間公司增聘人手來改善服務。
The new phone has an improved camera.
這支新手機的相機經過改良。

上週我們看到了這款應用程式的改良版。
Susan grows tomatoes in her small garden.
蘇珊在她的小花園裡種番茄。

蘇珊給了我一些關於考試的實用建議。

史雲頓是英格蘭南部的一個城鎮。

The bank is closed on Sundays.
銀行星期日不營業。
Please keep the door closed to keep the room warm.
請把門關著，讓房間保持溫暖。

closed.zh: 關上（close 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: She closed the window because it was getting cold.
天氣變冷，所以她把窗戶關上了。
The store closed early because of the typhoon.
那間店因颱風提早打烊。
The committee held a closed meeting to discuss the budget.
委員會召開了一場不公開的會議來討論預算。

我們參觀了一座羅馬浴場的遺跡。

這個慶典是在慶祝拉丁裔的音樂與美食。

美國許多拉丁裔同時會說西班牙語和英語。

這份調查詢問了每位拉丁裔受訪者的家鄉。
She is learning Korean so she can watch dramas without subtitles.
她正在學韓語，這樣就能不看字幕看韓劇。
Two Koreans sat next to us on the plane.
飛機上有兩位韓國人坐在我們旁邊。
We had Korean barbecue for dinner last night.
我們昨晚晚餐吃了韓式烤肉。
He bought a Korean dictionary at the bookstore.
他在書店買了一本韓語辭典。
The town is known for its hot springs.
這個小鎮以溫泉聞名。
There are no known cures for this rare disease.
這種罕見疾病目前沒有已知的治療方法。

known.zh: 知道、認識（know 的過去分詞）
ai: I have known her since we were children.
我從小就認識她。
Had I known about the traffic, I would have left earlier.
如果我早知道會塞車，我就會早點出門。
A valid passport is required to enter the country.
入境這個國家需要有效的護照。
Math is a required course for all first-year students.
數學是所有一年級學生的必修課。

required.zh: 需要、要求（require 的過去式與過去分詞）
ai: The job required her to work on weekends.
這份工作要求她週末上班。
The repair required more time than we had expected.
這項修理所需的時間比我們預期的還多。
She is a longtime friend of my family.
她是我家多年的老朋友。
He finally met his longtime pen pal in person.
他終於見到了通信多年的筆友。

jackson.zh: 傑克遜（美國密西西比州的首府）
ai: Jackson is the capital of the state of Mississippi.
傑克遜是密西西比州的首府。
They drove to Jackson to visit a friend over the weekend.
他們週末開車到傑克遜去探望朋友。
Her eighteenth birthday party was held at a small restaurant.
她的十八歲生日派對在一間小餐廳舉行。
He finished in eighteenth place in the race.
他在比賽中拿到第十八名。
An eighteenth of the budget goes to office supplies.
預算的十八分之一用在辦公用品上。
Each person received one eighteenth of the prize money.
每個人拿到獎金的十八分之一。

sussex.zh: 蘇塞克斯（英格蘭南部的郡）
ai: Sussex is a county on the south coast of England.
蘇塞克斯是英格蘭南岸的一個郡。
We spent a relaxing weekend in the Sussex countryside.
我們在蘇塞克斯的鄉間度過了一個悠閒的週末。
The miller ground the wheat into flour.
磨坊主人把小麥磨成麵粉。

在那個古老的故事裡，有一位磨坊主人住在河邊。

米勒先生是我們新來的數學老師。

請把包裹寄給橡樹街的米勒一家。
Ann waters the flowers in the morning.
安每天早上都會幫花澆水。
Ann and I are taking the same class this semester.
這學期安和我修同一門課。
Derek works as an electrician in our town.
德里克在我們鎮上當電工。
I invited Derek to our dinner on Friday.
我邀請了德里克來參加星期五的晚餐。
The lords of the castle held a great feast.
城堡的領主們舉辦了一場盛大的宴會。
In the Middle Ages, local lords owned most of the land.
中世紀時，大部分土地都由地方領主所擁有。
The bill was passed by the House of Commons and sent to the Lords.
這項法案在下議院通過後，被送交上議院。
The Lords will discuss the new law next week.
上議院下週將討論這項新法律。
The Wright brothers are famous for building one of the first airplanes.
萊特兄弟因製造出最早的飛機之一而聞名。
Wilbur and Orville Wright made the first powered airplane flights.
威爾伯與奧維爾．萊特完成了最早的動力飛機飛行。
Emily practices the piano for an hour every day.
艾蜜莉每天練一個小時的鋼琴。
I borrowed a pen from Emily during the test.
考試時我向艾蜜莉借了一支筆。

microsoft.zh: 微軟公司（美國的軟體公司）
ai: Microsoft is a software company based in the United States.
微軟是一間總部位於美國的軟體公司。
My father worked for Microsoft before he retired.
我爸爸退休前在微軟工作。

re.zh: 關於（常用於信件或電子郵件主旨）
ai: I'm writing re your request for a refund.
我寫信是想回覆你關於退款的要求。

她的電子郵件主旨寫著「回覆：週五的會議」。
Joan has lived in the same house for thirty years.
瓊在同一棟房子裡住了三十年。

瓊載我去了車站。
Leicester is a city in the middle of England.
萊斯特是英格蘭中部的一座城市。

我阿姨在萊斯特的一所學校教書。
Eric builds model airplanes in his free time.
艾瑞克在空閒時會製作飛機模型。
Eric is going to meet us at the cafe.
艾瑞克會到咖啡館和我們碰面。
Walter takes a long walk along the beach every evening.
沃爾特每天傍晚都會沿著海灘走很長一段路。
We asked Walter for directions to the post office.
我們向沃爾特問去郵局的路。
Barry tells the funniest jokes at every party.
巴里在每次派對上都講最好笑的笑話。
Barry spent the afternoon painting the fence.
巴里整個下午都在油漆籬笆。
Shakespeare wrote many famous plays, including Hamlet and Macbeth.
莎士比亞寫了許多著名的劇本，包括《哈姆雷特》和《馬克白》。
We read a short scene by Shakespeare in English class.
我們在英文課上讀了一小段莎士比亞的劇作。
Alex is learning how to cook Italian food.
亞歷克斯正在學做義大利菜。
I'll send the photos to Alex tonight.
我今晚會把照片寄給亞歷克斯。
Seoul is the capital of South Korea.
首爾是南韓的首都。

韓國位於東亞的一座半島上。

卡洛琳在市區的一間花店工作。
Caroline reminded us to bring our passports.
卡洛琳提醒我們要帶護照。
Christianity is one of the largest religions in the world.
基督教是世界上最大的宗教之一。
The students learned about the history of Christianity in Europe.
學生們學習了基督教在歐洲的歷史。
Tehran is the capital of Iran.
德黑蘭是伊朗的首都。
Iran is a large country in the Middle East.
伊朗是中東的一個大國。
